root.name: Semi-Slav Defense: Quiet Variation
root.moves: 1. d4 d5 2. c4 c6 3. Nf3 Nf6 4. e3 e6 5. Nbd2

overview: Both sides develop quietly with e3 and Nbd2, and Black keeps the Semi-Slav triangle c6-d5-e6 while developing ...Nbd7. The game usually continues with Bd3, then ...dxc4 Bxc4 and ...b5, heading for Meran-type ideas, or ...Bd6 and ...O-O. White tries e4 or a slow build-up; Black uses the c5 break to free the position.

white_ideas.idea: Develop Bd3 and O-O, then push e4 when ready
Capture on c4 with the bishop and meet ...b5 with Bd3
Keep a flexible centre and avoid the sharp Meran theory

black_ideas.idea: Keep ...Bd6 for e5 pressure and castle
Break with ...e5 or ...c5 to free pieces

typical_structures.structure: Semi-Slav triangle with c6, d5, e6 against c4, d4, e3
After ...dxc4 and ...b5 a Meran-type structure with a Black queenside majority

character.notes: Quiet development with little forcing play, and Black's structure is hard to break.

gambit.notes: Any pawn on c4 returns quickly; nothing is sacrificed.

soundness.notes: Respected main-line system for both sides.

structure.notes: The centre stays in tension until ...dxc4 or ...e5 resolves it.

approach.notes: A normal line of the Semi-Slav played by strong players.

level.notes: The plans are clear and theory is moderate.

sublines_that_differ.name: Meran-type 6.Bd3 dxc4 7.Bxc4 b5
sublines_that_differ.moves: 1. d4 d5 2. c4 c6 3. Nf3 Nf6 4. e3 e6 5. Nbd2 Nbd7 6. Bd3 dxc4 7. Bxc4 b5
sublines_that_differ.how: Black expands at once and the game becomes a more active Meran-style fight.
